about:
Mach Connections is headquartered in Bowling Green, Florida, where it operates as a subsidiary of the Correct Craft family of companies. The current entity was formed in 2022 when the business was acquired and rebranded, focusing its efforts on marine electrical systems.

The shop delivers four core services: OEM panel production, hydro graphics application, wire harness manufacturing, and battery cable assembly. An in-house engineering group assists with custom panel design and harness specification, though the company does not publish facility dimensions, employee counts, or annual volumes.

Customers span the marine sector, including original equipment manufacturers that integrate Mach Connections’ panels and harnesses into new boats, as well as individual boaters seeking replacement or upgrade cable assemblies. The company’s marketing highlights its specialization in marine electrical solutions.

Leadership points to the team’s extensive marine-industry experience as its primary differentiator, coupled with a consultative approach that aims to identify the most suitable electrical solution for each application rather than offering off-the-shelf products alone.

about:
MacroFab, Inc. is headquartered in Houston, Texas, where it operates an intelligent electronics manufacturing platform that combines AI-driven quoting, sourcing, and production tracking with a vetted network of U.S.-based factories.

The company provides turnkey PCB fabrication (2–36 layers, HDI, blind/buried/micro vias, controlled impedance), PCB assembly (SMD, through-hole, BGA, 01005 components, conformal coating, epoxy potting, IPC-A-610 Class 2/3, J-STD-001), and component sourcing (turnkey, consignment, alternative parts, lifecycle management).

MacroFab serves industrial controls, drones and autonomous systems, test and measurement, and defense/ITAR programs. Customers include Dresser Utility Solutions, VOTRONICS PREMIER, Octavo Systems, Broms Technologies, MannKind, Probe, and Task Force Tips, ranging from OEMs to engineering teams needing rapid iteration.

The company differentiates itself as the only ITAR‑registered self‑service PCB assembly platform, offering dedicated U.S.-based account managers, a fully audited factory network, real‑time BOM and supply‑chain visibility, and no minimum order requirements.

name: Madden Fabrication - Portland Metal Fab Shop
old_description: Madden Fabrication was founded in 1992 as a division of our parent company,
about:
Madden Fabrication operates from Portland, Oregon, where it was founded in 1992 as a division of a parent company. The business has remained in the same location for over three decades, serving the Pacific Northwest from a single facility.

The shop occupies 18,000 square feet and runs CNC plasma cutting, 120-ton and 50-ton ironworkers, a programmable draw bender, and a full suite of welding processes including GMAW, FCAW, GTAW, SMAW, and SAW. Design work is handled in-house with AutoCAD and SolidWorks. The company works with carbon steel, structural steel, stainless steel, aluminum, nickel alloys, and exotic metals, producing structural, architectural, and ornamental metal fabrications. It also provides field installation and repair within a roughly 100-mile radius of Portland.

Madden Fabrication serves industrial, commercial, and residential construction markets. Industrial clients include municipalities, geothermal projects, mills, and chemical plants, where the shop supplies valve and pipe assemblies, precision parts, and safety upgrades. Commercial work covers restaurants, retail spaces, new construction, and remodels, delivering handrails, guardrails, canopies, awnings, and building envelope components. Residential projects range from custom stair railings and balcony guards to gates and ornamental pieces for homeowners and designers. The portfolio also includes bridge components, parking garage structures, and multi-family housing.

The company emphasizes its 30-plus years of experience, adherence to relevant codes and standards, and a quality program developed under American Society of Mechanical Engineers guidelines. Its stated mission is "precision, innovation, excellence," aiming to build lasting client relationships through superior service and dedication to craft.

name: Magna Powertrain
old_description: Magna is the preferred global manufacturer of mechanical components for eDrive systems when precision, experience, and high volumes are required.
about:
Magna Powertrain operates as a dedicated powertrain group within Magna International, headquartered in Troy, Michigan, with significant operations in Muncie, Indiana. The division is led by President Diba Ilunga and functions as a long‑standing supplier to the global automotive industry.

The group designs, develops, tests, and manufactures a full spectrum of powertrain solutions: battery‑electric (BEV) drive units, hybrid systems ranging from 48‑volt mild hybrids to full HEV and PHEV architectures, and conventional modules such as transmissions, all‑wheel‑drive and four‑wheel‑drive units, disconnect systems, and internal‑combustion engine components. Magna Powertrain also produces mechanical components for eDrive systems and integrates hardware with vehicle‑level software. Production spans multiple global sites, including EMAS‑certified facilities that run on 100 % renewable electricity in Europe, and the group reports 97 % recyclability for its transmissions.

Customers are primarily global automotive OEMs seeking high‑volume, precision‑engineered propulsion hardware. A notable strategic partnership is the LG Magna e‑Powertrain joint venture with LG Electronics, aimed at accelerating growth in the electric‑powertrain market. The group serves passenger‑car and light‑commercial‑vehicle platforms across all major regions.

Magna Powertrain positions itself as the preferred source for eDrive mechanical components when precision, experience, and high volumes are required. Its differentiators include a broad electrification portfolio, the LG Magna joint venture, and a sustainability program that targets net‑zero operations, 100 % green electricity at European sites by 2025, and circular‑economy initiatives such as advanced recyclability and remanufacturing.

name: Magna-Power Electronics
old_description: Robust power processing topologies combined with state-of-the-art vertically integrated USA manufacturing and worldwide support.
about:
Magna-Power Electronics has operated from Flemington, New Jersey since its founding in 1981. The company designs and manufactures programmable DC power supplies and electronic loads at its vertically integrated headquarters, where engineering and production share the same campus.

The product line spans more than 250,000 configurations, with DC power supplies ranging from 1.5 kW to over 10,000 kW and electronic loads from 1.25 kW to 20 kW+. In-house capabilities include sheet-metal fabrication, CNC vertical and horizontal machining, wire EDM, robotic bonded-fin heat-sink assembly, SMT and through-hole PCB assembly, precision brazing for water-cooled magnetics, powder coating, custom wood packaging, and wire-harness fabrication across 14 assembly stations. The company reports 475+ megawatts shipped and 50,000+ units delivered, with a typical made-to-order build time of four to six weeks.

Customers range from startups to Fortune 500 firms in aerospace (GE Aviation, Lockheed Martin), defense (QinetiQ), academic research (University of Houston, George Washington University, Colorado School of Mines), robotics (Blue Robotics), energy (Alencon Systems), and hypersonic test facilities (UTSI).

Magna-Power attributes its differentiation to vertical integration, which gives complete control over quality, cost, and lead times, and to a unified control platform (MagnaLINK™) that keeps firmware, commands, and I/O consistent across product families. Stocked common assemblies enable the cited four-to-six-week lead times.

name: Magnum Electronics
old_description: As digital RF voice communications transitions to IP-based wireless networks, we are focusing our efforts to increase training on LTE network technology, software applications, and interoperability. In 2014, Magnum Electronics became a certified Cradlepoint Partner to support public-safety agencies for mobile cellular connectivity. After significant growth and technical certifications, we're now a Premier level partner and a leading provider of LTE 4G wireless networks.
about:
Magnum Electronics, Inc. is a family-owned communications systems integrator headquartered in Dover, Delaware. The company focuses on supporting mission-critical emergency workers in government and enterprise.

The firm supplies and services public-safety digital two-way radio systems, 4G LTE wireless networks, rugged mobile computers, and GPS fleet management solutions. As a Motorola Solutions Elite Channel Partner, Manufacturer Representative, and Service Partner Center, it provides an extensive selection of radio accessories from brands such as David Clark and 3M Peltor. Its certified factory-trained technical staff offers system design for RF, LTE, and WiFi networks, FCC licensing assistance, professional installation and vehicle upfitting, fleet management with AI-powered video telematics, bench-level repair and programming, and flexible radio rentals using nationwide FCC frequencies. The company also holds State of Delaware contracts for equipment and installation services and is an approved vendor for Delaware SB79 in-building public-safety coverage testing.

Magnum serves law enforcement, fire and EMS agencies, government entities, enterprise customers, educational institutions, and businesses. Its solutions address public-safety communications, construction and public-works fleets, and mobile workforce connectivity.

The company differentiates itself through its Cradlepoint partnership for LTE 4G wireless networks, factory-certified repair with serial-number configuration archiving, and membership in the Enterprise Wireless Alliance. Its focus on interoperability and training in LTE network technology aims to bridge the transition from digital RF voice to IP-based wireless networks.

name: Maine Woodworks
old_description: We build custom-made furniture in Maine—thoughtful, well-made pieces designed to fit your home and your life.
about:
Maine Woodworks, based in Saco, Maine, was founded in 1991. The company builds custom-made furniture, emphasizing thoughtful design and craftsmanship.

The company produces a range of residential furniture including bedroom, dining, entryway, office, and occasional pieces. Each item is handcrafted in Maine using regionally sourced sustainable hardwood and traditional joinery such as four-corner English dovetails. Finishes are eco-friendly and inspired by the natural colors of Maine. Production is made-to-order, allowing customers to customize panel styles, leg designs, hardware, and finishes. The workshop also offers assembly services and white-glove delivery scheduling.

Maine Woodworks serves primarily residential customers seeking heirloom-quality pieces for their homes. It also operates a Trade & Hospitality program catering to interior designers, contractors, and hospitality clients such as hotels and inns. The company’s furniture has been specified for commercial projects, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The business was started to create well-made, customizable furniture that fits the way people live. The company highlights its combination of elevated design and exceptional craftsmanship, with a focus on durability—building pieces intended to last for generations. Its differentiators include Maine-based handcrafting, sustainable materials, dovetail joinery, and a made-to-order model with a typical lead time of six to eight weeks.

name: Majors Plastics Inc.
old_description: Majors Plastics is a leading provider of precision injection molding solutions, offering high and medium volume production of tightly-toleranced components with exacting quality standards, supported by decades of technical expertise and state-of-the-art manufacturing infrastructure.
about:
Majors Plastics Inc. was founded in 1953 by Ben Pfeiffer and Eli Dahir in Omaha, Nebraska. The company relocated to its current Plant One location in 1968 and became a 100% employee-owned ESOP in 2013 after expanding the plan from its initial adoption in 1993.

The company operates four molding facilities across the United States and Mexico, specializing in precision injection molding, overmolding, insert molding, two-shot molding, and ISO Class-7 cleanroom molding. Its Omaha campus spans over 300,000 square feet and houses more than 120 molding machines, while the Reynosa, Mexico facility adds 128,000 square feet with 36 machines. Approximately 500 employees support high- and medium-volume production, complemented by assembly and secondary services such as ultrasonic welding, heat staking, pad printing, and custom packaging.

Majors Plastics serves pharmaceutical, medical device, health and safety, energy, consumer electronics, and tableware markets. Longstanding customers include 3M, which has recognized the company multiple times with its Supplier of the Year Award, and Becton Dickinson (BD), which named it a Supply Chain Excellence Supplier of the Year. The firm secured its first medical products customer in 1985 and has since diversified into energy-related components and rigid computer disc preparatory operations.

The company emphasizes personalized customer relationships from initial design concept through finished product, providing engineering support throughout mold design and manufacturing. Its quality system is built on ISO 9001:2015 registration, statistical process control, and C=0 sampling plans to meet customer AQL levels as low as 0.040.
